text_block_list.name: Spe & Grass
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhh!! Haaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(—!? Is this... the running of the Golden 
Generation?!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(It's way beyond what I imagined... But 
we've built up so much of our own strength 
too!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Opera O-chan... never yielding an inch.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Doto-chan—she never gives up.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Ayabe-san—as fast as a shooting star.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I am who I am today because I've competed 
with everyone! My running, polished to the 
absolute limit—!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And shouldering all that support and 
expectation, I will walk this path—!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaahhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She broke through!! Narita! It's Narita!! 
Narita Top Road!!!!!! Across the finish 
liiiiine now!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: U-Ah, uuuugh...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And a deafening roar! The model student 
roars! A true culmination of her efforts! 
A picture-perfect, flawless victory!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What decided the outcome was likely— the 
difference in the weight of expectations 
and their own sensitivity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, more than anyone else, Narita Top 
Road was one with her peers, and one with 
everyone cheering her on.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Top Road-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Congrats.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Congratulations~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations. Your resolve was truly 
magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Top Road-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is so strong. I was honestly 
surprised.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"The pleasure is all mine... You really 
surprised me. And you've taught me quite a 
valuable lesson."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"It's the same in every generation, isn't 
it? Pushing and polishing each other to 
get this far..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is amazing... Everyone is truly 
wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I'll never forget this for the rest of my 
life. Getting to run alongside such 
incredible Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to cherish this as a treasure 
in my heart forever and ever!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A Grand Prix where champions of two 
generations gathered. And the Umamusume 
who ran alongside them were...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was etched deeply into Narita Top 
Road's heart. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: How is it? The view from the top?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm at a loss for words... I just feel so 
incredibly happy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A dream I had as a child... To that 
faraway dreamland...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
To think I could actually reach it. Just 
how difficult, how impossible it was to 
make it this far...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you... Thank you so much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes... As the responsibility of one who 
has achieved it...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I want to make sure I convey this 
gratitude to everyone as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to stand right beside her in the 
winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road and I are one in body and 
soul. I wanted to show our gratitude 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all very much for coming out 
today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Standing in this place, what I really 
want to say above all is—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I have nothing but... utter gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan, Ayabe-san, Doto-chan, who 
have run alongside me this far. Thank you 
so much.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Without the three of them, I wouldn't be 
who I am today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And to Spe-chan, Grass-chan, King-chan, 
and Tsurumaru-chan. Thank you very much 
for the match.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Witnessing everyone's strength made me 
feel that I must discipline myself even 
further.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: And—! Above all else—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road was finally overcome with 
emotion, unable to hold back what she had 
kept inside—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
To all of our friends and fans who have 
supported me—who have supported us—all the 
way here!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The only reason I've made it this far is 
thanks to everyone's expectations...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you so very much!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Great work today!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Top Roooad! Top Ro~ad!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the roar of the entire crowd—tears 
stream down. And then, a radiant smile 
breaks through.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road has reached the summit. 
However, the road does not end here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The path of light—surpasses the peak and 
stretches far, far into the distance."
